purpose: The sources a generative AI response drew on (Cloudscape's sources section, AI Elements Sources): a rounded `Sources` pill with the overlapping marks of up to three sources (the item's `icon` or its site's first letter) that opens an ordered list — mark, linked title, description or site. It ends the message's action row (`ChatMessage.Actions` `#trailing`). Item `n` has the id `<anchor>-source-<n>`, the target of `StreamingResponse`'s `[n]` citations; following one opens the list and brings the item into view.
useWhen: A response is grounded in documents, pages or records the reader may want to open or verify.
avoidWhen: Related links that the response did not use → `help-panel` links or a plain list.
A single source → cite it inline with a link; a list of one is noise.
related: `chat-message` — the pill goes in the `#trailing` slot of `ChatMessage.Actions`, after the icon actions.
bestPractices: Order items as the response first cites them, so `[1]` is item 1.
Use the page title, not the URL, as the title; the site shows on its own from `href`, so the description is for the section (`Azion documentation · Cache`).
Give `icon` only for a site whose glyph is in the icon set (`az az-github`).
Keep the list collapsed by default; the inline citations are the primary path.
